headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to favor American-made goods and American workers in government buying and hiring-related rules.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to put more weight on buying products made in the United States and on protecting jobs for American workers. It is widely understood to address rules for federal government purchasing and work visa programs. No official summary was provided, so the specific details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that sell goods to the federal government
who_it_affects.how: They may face stricter expectations to supply American-made products.
They are directed to follow American-preference policies in their buying and related decisions.

who_it_affects.group: US workers and foreign workers seeking US jobs
who_it_affects.how: Hiring-related rules, such as those for work visas, may be reviewed with a focus on American workers.
